author: Rebiz
name: Backups
install_msg: Configure Backblaze B2 credentials in your .env (B2_KEY_ID, B2_APPLICATION_KEY, B2_BUCKET_NAME), then restart.
short: Automated database backups to Backblaze B2 with scheduled uploads and /backup commands.
description: Schedules periodic compressed backups of the bot's data directory and uploads them to a Backblaze B2 bucket. Provides /backup run and /backup list slash commands for manual control and listing uploads.
